1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module seventeen: Exam Technique and Final Review. This module covers pacing, method and final review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. A time plan for sixty items in one hundred twenty minutes. How to read a scenario item, find the real question and eliminate distractors. Multiple-response tactics. Rules, policies and logistics on exam day, and what happens after.

1.title: Case Check-In: Birchwood Supply
1.text: Our running case is Birchwood Supply. Birchwood Supply. The solution architect meets the topic of this module. Your job: decide, step by step, which design choice fits.

1.title: Time Plan
1.text: Time Plan. The figure shows this: A three-part time plan: a quick first pass, a second pass for marked items, and a final check of multiple-response counts.

1.title: Time Plan, continued
1.text: Time Plan, continued. First pass. Time: about eighty min. What to do: Answer what you know in about eighty seconds per item; mark doubtful items and move on. Second pass. Time: about thirty min. What to do: Return to marked items; use elimination. Final check. Time: about ten min. What to do: Confirm every item is answered and every multiple-response item has the required number of selections. The guide describes no deduction for wrong answers, so answer every item; never leave one blank. You must stay on camera (online) and may not use notes, phones or other material. Exam tip: Mark a hard item and move on: it costs the time of two easy ones.

1.title: Reading a Scenario Item
1.text: Reading a Scenario Item. Read the last sentence first ("What is the most effective first step?", "Which approach best...?") so you know what to look for. Read the scenario facts: logs, numbers and which agent behaved correctly. The cause is usually stated. Spot trigger words.

1.title: Reading a Scenario Item, continued
1.text: Reading a Scenario Item, continued. "must", "always", "guarantee", "financial", "compliance". Programmatic enforcement (rule one). "first step", "most effective way to start". The proportionate, low-effort fix (rule three). "root cause", "logs show". The upstream cause (rule two). "blocking", "developers wait". Synchronous A P I (rule eight). "overnight", "weekly", "nightly". Batch (rule eight). "spread across the codebase". Glob-pattern path rules (Module seven). "limited context budget". Structured, compact upstream output (Module twelve). "conflicting sources". Keep both with attribution (Module fourteen). Predict the answer before reading the options, then match. Exam tip: The cause is usually stated in the stem (logs, numbers, which agent worked correctly).

1.title: Eliminating Distractors
1.text: Eliminating Distractors. Cross out answers that rely on the model "remembering to" do something required. Cross out heavy infrastructure (new classifier, routing layer, fine-tuning) when a simple fix has not been tried. Cross out answers that hide information (generic errors, empty successes, dropping a conflicting value). Cross out answers that give an agent more tools or more context than its role needs. Cross out claims that a bigger context window or extended thinking fixes the problem (a bigger window does not fix attention quality; extended thinking does not replace independent review).

1.title: Eliminating Distractors, continued
1.text: Eliminating Distractors, continued. Between two valid answers, pick the one that is deterministic, specific, scoped and proportionate.

1.title: Multiple-response items
1.text: Multiple-response items. The stem says how many to select: choose exactly that number. Judge each option on its own against the requirement; do not choose "pairs that sound alike". If you can find only one clear answer, the second is usually the companion safeguard (for example a gate plus a handoff), not a repeat of the first. Exam tip: When two answers would work, choose the deterministic, specific, scoped and proportionate one.

1.title: Policies and Logistics
1.text: Policies and Logistics. Registration. Through the Anthropic Partner Academy and Pearson V U E; pay at checkout; schedule online-proctored or at a test center. Reschedule or cancel. Up to twenty-four hours before; later changes forfeit the fee. I D. Valid government photo I D; the name must match the registration exactly. Accommodations. Request and get approval from Pearson V U E before scheduling. Agreements. You accept a confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement before the exam; never share or reproduce exam content. Retakes. fourteen or thirty or ninety days; max four attempts per rolling twelve months; fee each time.

1.title: Policies and Logistics, continued
1.text: Policies and Logistics, continued. Result. Pass or fail and scaled score, plus percent correct per domain. Validity and renewal. twelve months; on-time renewal is a free, non-proctored assessment; if it lapses, retake the full exam. Appeals. Within fourteen days; the passing standard and item content are not appealable. Exam guides and exams are updated; the Architect to Foundations guide is version one point zero (July two thousand twenty-six). Check the Partner Academy for a newer guide, the current fee and eligibility before you book. As of eight November two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: Final Review Checklist
1.text: Final Review Checklist. [ ] I can state the ten decision rules without looking. [ ] I can explain tool use or end turn and three loop anti-patterns. [ ] I know why hooks beat prompts for hard rules, and what the handoff contains. [ ] I can write a good tool description and a structured error. [ ] I know Claude dot M D levels, rules with paths, skills frontmatter, plan versus direct, dash p C L I (command-line interface) flags. [ ] I know tool use plus schema, nullable fields, retry limits, batch rules and S L A (service level agreement) math. [ ] I know case facts, scratchpads, escalation triggers, error context, stratified sampling, claim-source mapping.

1.title: Final Review Checklist, continued
1.text: Final Review Checklist, continued. [ ] I have built at least a small agent loop, a Claude dot M D with a rule file and a schema-based extraction.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Time: about eighty s per item; mark and return; check multiple-response counts. Method: Read the question first, find the stated cause, predict, eliminate. Eliminate: Prompt-only for hard rules, over-engineering, hidden errors, too many tools, "bigger window". Pick: Deterministic, specific, scoped, proportionate. Logistics: Photo I D with exact name, twenty-four-hour change rule, N D A (non-disclosure agreement), retakes fourteen or thirty or ninety days, valid twelve months. In the next module, we continue the course.
